reviews.text: The service is wonderful. They are super attentive and treat our pets with great care.

I really like the environment. It's clean, organized, and the service is excellent. I've been getting my puppy's baths and grooming done there for a while now, and I love it. Knowing that he's being cared for with love and respect is priceless. Plus, they allow us to watch the bath, which, in my case, keeps my little one calm.

The service is always very attentive and the staff treats the pets with care. However, about a year ago I noticed the grooming had a more meticulous finish: the dogs would come back smelling better, with well-made bows and sometimes even braids.

Currently the result is simpler. Still, I appreciate the fact that they come back well-groomed and, most importantly, without ticks, something that has happened in other establishments.

I've been a client for over three years and I only have praise to offer. The team is made up of extremely competent, qualified, and dedicated professionals. They always treat my four pets with great affection, attention, and care, which gives me complete confidence. The bathing and grooming service is impeccable. This dedication is unparalleled and priceless. I recommend them to everyone who seeks quality and love for animals!”
